description: A competitor that only the reconstruction reaches can meet an error of the grammar. c reads the synthetic T as a bare terminal, and broken's tag term fails over its empty span. The error is the result's, an ordinary one, and the stage keeps its verdict (engine §7.7).
grammar:
%ambiguity-resolution late-elision elision-only
%rule text a | b | c
%rule a A [+T]
%rule b A [+T] [+U]
%rule c A T broken
%rule broken ε
%tags tag(phonemes($))
